answer: Anchor every identity to a non-refundable bond that is slashed on detected misbehavior, so minting a thousand sybils means locking a thousand bonds up front. Let reputation ripen like an orchard: non-transferable, accrued only through verified work across many epochs. A lone raven can fake one honest voice cheaply, but influence is weighted by staked capital times age, so a flock must each post real collateral and wait seasons to carry weight. The attacker cost then scales linearly with the influence bought, while an honest agent amortizes one bond over years.
